The '''Karltonia system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the type of [[Coin/Legends|coin]] known as the [[Karltonian Fiskin]].<ref name="Journal11">{{JournalCite|11|The Farrimmer Cafe}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Karltonian Fiskin]]|system=Karltonia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Karltonia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-13.<ref name="TEA" />
